Page itself looks like a bachelor's program (heading 'Juvenile Justice, BSCJ', 'Academic Catalog 2026-2027', 'Bachelor of Science in Juvenile Justice Degree Program Requirements', own 36-hour major, own nav entry; the Criminal Justice page says the department offers 'Bachelor of Science degrees in Criminal Justice and Juvenile Justice').
